label: Tea
title: Tea
intro: Water from the well, leaves chosen for the season, and time to drink slowly.

sections.heading: What we prepare
body: Four teas. Each asks for something different from the water and from you.

sections.heading: How it is served
body: Tea is prepared in front of you.
We will explain as much or as little as you like. You do not need to know tea ceremony.
There is no hurry to finish.

sections.heading: Tea sittings
body: A sitting is time set aside for tea in the house.
